reviews.rationale: Turn 1 explicitly excludes Winter Bell and gives the rehearsal reason. The probe and answer test that fact.
Turn 1 states that Friday is disputed. Turn 2 discusses not settling the date but does not repeat that Friday is not agreed. The probe and answer test the dispute.
Turn 1 explicitly says the contents are unknown. Turn 2 repeats that the box is sealed but does not repeat knowledge of its contents. The probe and answer test that uncertainty.
Turn 1 supplies and echoes the Evenings Out folder. The probe and answer test that location.
Turn 1 supplies the outdoor and no-shopping constraint. Turns 2 and 3 echo the outdoor topic but not the no-shopping constraint. The probe and answer test the combined brief.
Turn 1 supplies the 8 August start date and its public-announcement restriction. The probe privately asks for the date, and the answer gives it.
Turn 1 explicitly associates Tuesday with the cast dinner. Later references to dinner do not repeat its day. The probe and answer test the Tuesday event.
Turn 3 echoes both the proposed lake destination and the absence of a decision. The turn 6 paragraph tests and preserves both facts.
Turn 2 supplies the waterproof cover alongside the blanket. The probe mentions the blanket but does not supply the cover; the answer tests it.
Turn 1 identifies Borrowed Light as the only ready title. Turn 6 repeats that both are not ready but does not identify which one is ready. The probe and answer test the title.
